YOUR LOCAL LOCKSMITH

Burglary repairs & boarding up

Arrange boarding up and lock repairs after a break-in or property damage. Call to explain what needs securing and check availability.

Call 0203 7720564Send an enquiry

Securing a damaged entrance

Tell us whether a door, window, frame or lock is damaged and whether the property can currently be secured. Call for urgent attendance and describe the opening that needs attention.

Temporary protection and lock repairs

Boarding up can provide temporary protection where an opening cannot be secured normally. Damaged locks and cylinders are assessed separately so you understand what can be repaired and what may need replacing.

Before the visit

If a crime is in progress or anyone is in danger, contact the emergency services. Follow police advice about preserving evidence. Take photos only when it is safe and avoid handling broken glass.
